meta.title: Erveca Studio — Indie Videogames from La Rioja
meta.desc: Erveca Studio is an indie game studio based in Cameros, La Rioja (Spain). Creators of Almazuela Picross and the RPG Erveca, inspired by Riojan rural culture.
meta.keywords: La Rioja videogames, Cameros videogames, indie studio Spain, rural videogames, Riojan culture, almazuelas, Erveca Studio, Almazuela Picross
hero.title:
Games with
a Riojan soul
hero.desc: We are Erveca Studio, a small indie game studio based in Pradillo, in the Cameros mountains. We create experiences born from the land, the traditions and the identity of our region.
hero.caption: Almazuela scraps
games.label: Our titles
games.title: What we're creating
goddess.alt: Capsule art for Erveca: Goddess of the skies
goddess.desc: Explore the islands that were once the Erveca valley using the ancient magic of the Goddesses, and recover the tiles of Pradillo, a village of the old County of Nieva.
picross.desc: A cozy nonogram game inspired by La Rioja's textile tradition. Solve picross puzzles to unlock fabric scraps and assemble real almazuelas lent by artisans from Pradillo.
erveca.desc: Our flagship project: an adventure RPG with a medieval fantasy look, set in the Cameros region of La Rioja, supported by the Government of La Rioja.
about.label: Who we are
about.title:
A small studio
with a lot of land
about.p1: We are Samuel Noval and Isabel López, two developers based in Pradillo, a small village in the Riojan mountains. Since 2023 we have been making games that celebrate the culture, landscape and traditions of La Rioja.
about.p2: Our games are born from the land: the nonograms of Almazuela Picross pay tribute to the almazuelas made by the artisans of Pradillo; Erveca travels through the valleys of Cameros. Every pixel has roots.
